title: StrideRun Pro sizing guidance
content: StrideRun Pro runs about a half size small. Customers between sizes should size up. Wide (2E) fits are available in sizes 8 to 12 only. Exchanges for size are free within 30 days per the support handbook.

title: Cleaning and drying StrideRun Pro
content: Hand wash with mild soap and cold water. Remove the insole and air dry for 24 hours away from direct heat. Never machine dry: heat above 50C warps the foam midsole and voids the defect coverage.

title: Squeaking in the left or right shoe
content: A squeak under the arch is almost always trapped moisture under the insole, not a defect. Remove the insole, dry both parts for 24 hours, and dust the footbed lightly with talc. If squeaking persists after drying, treat it as a defect claim.

title: Sole separation within 90 days
content: Sole separation at the toe within 90 days of purchase is a known manufacturing defect for batches produced in Q2 2026. Offer a replacement in the same size or a full refund regardless of the 30-day return window. Log it as a product defect with the batch code printed inside the tongue.

title: When to replace running shoes
content: Running shoes should be replaced after roughly 500 to 800 km. Visible midsole creasing and uneven outsole wear are normal wear, not defects, and are not covered by warranty.

title: Washing a down jacket
content: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle with the zipper closed. Tumble dry on low with two clean tennis balls to restore loft. Do not dry clean: solvents strip the water-repellent finish.

title: Stuck or misaligned zipper
content: Rub graphite from a pencil along the zipper teeth, then work the slider gently. If a tooth is missing or the slider is cracked, the jacket qualifies for a free zipper repair or an exchange within 30 days.

title: Outerwear fit guidance
content: Contoso outerwear is cut for layering. Customers who plan to wear only a t-shirt underneath should consider one size down. Size exchanges are free within 30 days.

title: Water beading stops working
content: Loss of water beading is normal after 10 to 20 washes. Re-apply a spray-on durable water repellent and tumble dry on low to reactivate it. This is not a defect.

title: Resetting Pulse earbuds
content: Place both earbuds in the case, hold the case button for 15 seconds until the light flashes amber three times, then re-pair from the phone's Bluetooth settings.

title: One earbud will not charge
content: Clean the gold charging contacts on the earbud and inside the case with a dry cotton swab. If the earbud still does not charge after cleaning, it is covered by the 1-year limited warranty.

title: Charging case becomes hot
content: If the charging case becomes hot to the touch, the customer must stop using it and unplug it immediately. This is a safety issue: escalate to a human agent right away and log a product defect. Do not troubleshoot further.

title: Opened electronics returns
content: Opened, non-defective electronics may be returned within 30 days with a 15 percent restocking fee. Defective electronics are exempt from the fee. Confirm the defect before waiving the fee.

title: Lamp not connecting to Wi-Fi
content: The Glow Smart Lamp supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only. Ask the customer to switch the phone to the 2.4 GHz network during setup, then hold the lamp's power button for 10 seconds to restart pairing mode.

title: Descaling the BrewMaster
content: Descale monthly: fill the reservoir with equal parts white vinegar and water, run a full brew cycle, then run two cycles with plain water.

title: Error E2 on the display
content: E2 means the water reservoir is not seated. Remove the reservoir and push it back until it clicks.

title: Error E4 or overheating
content: E4 indicates overheating. Tell the customer to unplug the unit and let it cool for 30 minutes. If E4 appears again, the customer must stop using the unit: escalate as a safety issue and log a product defect.

title: Knife care and warranty
content: Hand wash and dry immediately; dishwashers dull and pit the blades. The lifetime warranty covers handle defects and blade breakage under normal use, not dullness or rust from dishwasher use.

title: New mat odor
content: A light rubber odor is normal for up to 7 days. Unroll the mat and air it out away from direct sunlight. Odor alone is not a defect.

title: Mat feels slippery
content: New mats can feel slippery for the first 3 to 5 sessions. Wiping the surface with a damp cloth and mild soap speeds up break-in.

title: Band tears or snaps
content: Visible nicks or tears mean the band must be retired immediately; a snapping band can cause eye injury. If a band tears within 90 days during normal use, treat it as a defect and log it with the safety flag.

title: Cleaning the backpack
content: Spot clean only. Machine washing deforms the laptop sleeve padding and is not covered by warranty.

title: Backpack lifetime warranty
content: The lifetime warranty covers zippers, buckles, and seams. It does not cover fabric abrasion or damage from overloading beyond the rated 12 kg.

title: How to log a product defect
content: Every defect report needs the product name, the symptom, the days since purchase, whether there is any safety risk, and the batch or serial code when the customer can provide it. Never include the customer's name, email, phone number, or address in a defect log.
